tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search open and closed issues in the current repository by keywords. Use when the user asks about existing bugs or feature requests. Returns up to 20 issues, newest first.

query.description: Keywords to match in title and body

function.name: create_issue
function.description: Create a new issue with a title and body. Use when the user wants to report a bug or request a feature. Do not use to look up issues.
